cron.description: 6-field Quartz cron of the nightly consolidation (MEMORY_DREAM_CRON). Documentation, not a params field: a timer cell has no `cron` param, the value lives inside the schedule at params.schedules[0].cron and is edited there (or at runtime with a modify op by schedule_id).

description.purpose: Fires the nightly consolidation. It sends, it does not generate: event_id becomes the run id and fired_at becomes the window end — the two values that make a dream run identifiable and idempotent.
description.use_when: Inside the memory hive; change the schedule at runtime with add/modify/remove ops by schedule_id.
description.not_in_scope: No catch-up. Missed firings are dropped by design — the next run's window starts at the last completed one, so a skipped night is covered automatically.
description.emits_meaning: hop.event_id/fired_at are promoted to context.dream_run/dream_to by the edge and clock the whole run; the body is a plain trigger.
description.consumes_meaning: Schedule ops (add/modify/remove by schedule_id) as body.op.
